# EIAAW Solutions

> EIAAW Solutions builds ethical AI-human partnerships — products that amplify the people doing the work instead of replacing them. Based in Kuala Lumpur, serving Malaysia and APAC.

EIAAW Solutions (SSM 202603133419, CT0164540-H) is a Malaysian AI company that builds AI-native business platforms with humans in every approval gate. Every engagement starts with an AI Impact Assessment grounded in seven non-negotiable ethics principles: Human Dignity First, Transparency, Fairness, Human Oversight, Privacy & Data, Continuous Learning, and True Partnership.

We sell four end-to-end products — for revenue, creative, the people behind the work, and the brand voice on every social channel — all built on the same EIAAW ethics framework.

## Products

- [Sales Agent (sa.eiaawsolutions.com)](https://sa.eiaawsolutions.com): An AI sales partner that generates qualified leads with reasoning, drafts personalised email + LinkedIn outreach, runs voice AI for first conversations, and supports content. Humans control strategy and close. From RM 99 / month.
- [Ai Ads Agency (ads.eiaawsolutions.com)](https://ads.eiaawsolutions.com): A full paid-advertising studio. Brand DNA extraction from any website, multi-platform campaign planning, on-brand AI ad creatives, and 250+ audit checks across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Apple and YouTube. Budget, ROAS / CPA modelling and A/B-test design built in.
- [Workforce (ep.eiaawsolutions.com)](https://ep.eiaawsolutions.com): Run an entire organisation in one click. EIAAW Workforce unifies three departments — HR, IT, and Accounting — on a single AI-native, multi-tenant backbone. The full employee journey, IT asset workflow with auto-AARF, full HRM (leave, payroll, EA forms, attendance, EPF / SOCSO / EIS / PCB statutory submissions for LHDN, KWSP, PERKESO, HRDC) and a full-fledged accounting ledger (Chart of Accounts, GL, AR/AP, invoices, POs, banking, fixed assets, budgeting, tax returns) move on one tenant with zero CSV exports. Postgres Row-Level Security per tenant. HR AI assistant grounded on tenant data with row-level citations. From USD 6 per active employee per month, 14-day trial, no credit card.
- [Social Media Team (smt.eiaawsolutions.com)](https://smt.eiaawsolutions.com): An autonomous AI social media platform with receipts. Six specialised agents — Strategist, Writer, Designer, Scheduler, Community, and Compliance — collaborate to plan a monthly calendar, draft brand-grounded captions, generate on-brand visuals (FAL.AI Flux locked to your palette/typography/logo), schedule across platforms via Blotato, draft community replies, and gate every post through five compliance checks (brand-voice threshold, factual grounding, embargo, prior-post deduplication, image brand-DNA). Every post ships with receipts: source brand evidence, modelled-on prior post, brand-voice score, compliance result, model and cost. Flat brand-based pricing — no per-user tax — and white-label included from the Studio tier.

## Ethics framework

1. Human Dignity First — every solution must make work more meaningful, not obsolete.
2. Transparency — no black boxes; we explain how systems work in plain language.
3. Fairness — active, measured testing to reduce algorithmic bias.
4. Human Oversight — AI suggests, drafts, analyses; humans make the final call.
5. Privacy & Data — TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, row-level tenant isolation; GDPR / CCPA / PDPA-aligned, clear data residency.
6. Continuous Learning — built-in feedback loops to detect drift and measure impact.
7. True Partnership — we collaborate with teams, we don't dictate.
